Privacy notice

Concept website · Updated October 10, 2026

This is a static website concept. The pathway demo uses preset examples in your browser and does not request learner names or education records.

Demo information

When you use the pathway sketcher, your topic and learning preference are processed locally in your browser to display an example sequence. The demo does not save or send these selections to an Orbytechz server.

Contact link

The contact link opens an email draft in your email application. The draft is not sent unless you choose to send it. The draft is addressed to hello@orbytechz.online. Confirm that this is a monitored inbox before public use.

Technical information

This prototype has no account system, analytics, advertising trackers, or backend. It may request web fonts while connected to the internet; system fonts are used if those fonts are unavailable.

Future platform

A production learning platform could process learner profiles, coursework, progress, and educator feedback. Before launch, the operator should publish an updated policy explaining what data is collected, why it is used, who may access it, how long it is retained, and how learners or guardians can exercise their rights.

This notice describes only the local concept site, not a future hosted Orbytechz service.
